page.overview:
What is 1987 Winchester Drive?

The Wallace residence is the household of the Wallace family, consisting of: Lindsey Wallace and her parents. It is located on 1987 Winchester Drive.

On Halloween 2007, Annie Brackett was hired to watch over Lindsey but she decided to make some plans with her boyfriend Paul. Annie arranaged with her friend Laurie Strode to babysit Lindsey while Annie was alone with Paul. Once Lindsey was dropped off, Annie and Paul went back to the Wallace house to be intimate but they were attacked by Michael Myers. Paul was killed and Annie was also assaulted, yet she managed to survive.
